question: Select the musical instrument which is NOT played by way of percussion or NOT played by way of striking any object?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shehnai**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shehnai** is a wind instrument, which means it is played by blowing air into it, not by percussion or striking.
 
• The other options listed, such as **Pakhawaj, Drum, and Tabla**, are all percussion instruments that produce sound by being struck.
 
• The **Shehnai** is commonly used in traditional Indian music, especially in auspicious occasions and ceremonies.
 
• It has a distinct, melodious sound that is different from the rhythmic beats produced by percussion instruments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Shehnai** is believed to bring good luck and is an integral part of North Indian weddings and festivals.
 
• It is made of wood with a double reed at one end and a metal or wooden flared bell at the other end.
 
• The instrument has been popularized globally by renowned musicians like **Ustad Bismillah Khan**.
 
• Learning to play the Shehnai requires significant practice and skill, as the musician must control the breath and finger movements precisely.
